title: Warehouse Transfer Authorization Form
subtitle: Warehouse Transfer: bounds the decision, conditions, and expiry.
description: Warehouse Transfer Authorization Form controls inventory unit, source bin, destination bin, transfer order, handling unit, and posting by tying each Warehouse Transfer custody, document, or movement decision to the inventory / custody authority, a stated boundary, and an expiry. The inventory transfer coordinator preserves conditions, exceptions, confirmation, and both sides of the handoff.
use_case: Use Warehouse Transfer Authorization Form at source warehouse, staging lane, vehicle or conveyance, and destination warehouse. Check applicable Warehouse Transfer requirements, list the affected quantity, value, document, route, or custody action, and state its limit. Record whether the inventory / custody authority approves, conditions, holds, or declines the request; obtain renewed consent before changing inventory unit, source bin, destination bin, transfer order, handling unit, and posting scope.

sections.title: Authorization request and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Warehouse Transfer, identify responsible parties, source warehouse, staging lane, vehicle or conveyance, and destination warehouse, and the linked inventory unit, source bin, destination bin, transfer order, handling unit, and posting source.

Source, destination, handling-unit, and seal identifiers

sections.title: Authorization basis and bounded decision
sections.guidance: Capture Warehouse Transfer facts for inventory unit, source bin, destination bin, transfer order, handling unit, and posting; include result, limit, source, and next control.

sections.title: Bounded approval and authorizer acknowledgment
sections.guidance: Resolve open Warehouse Transfer conditions; have inventory transfer coordinator assign the next Warehouse Transfer owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Decision limits, holds, and retained evidence
items: Wrong item, lot, serial, or destination
blocks.guidance: Pause Warehouse Transfer when physical quantity, identity, custody, destination receipt, or system posting remains unresolved. Retain the available Warehouse Transfer proof and route unresolved inventory unit, source bin, destination bin, transfer order, handling unit, and posting scope to inventory transfer coordinator.
